title: Bee Removal in Piscataway, NJ
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Piscataway, NJ. NJDEP-licensed, insured technicians. Wall void nests, ground colonies, structural work. (855) 930-5016.
intro: Stinging insects in Piscataway — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — require professional treatment when nests establish themselves in wall voids, soffits, attics, or structural wood. The Best Pest Control NYC provides complete nest identification, treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing throughout Piscataway. Our licensed technicians handle every nest location, from paper wasp colonies in eaves to aggressive yellow jacket nests inside walls, with the equipment and experience the job demands.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience serving Piscataway and surrounding New Jersey communities with reliable, eco-friendly bee removal solutions. Our team of licensed or supervised professionals uses proven techniques to safely relocate bees, preventing property damage and ensuring the safety of your family, pets, and customers.
localContext: Piscataway's residential neighborhoods near Rutgers University, commercial districts along Route 287, and green spaces like Johnson Park create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests to establish themselves in eaves, wall voids, soffits, and trees. The mix of historic properties downtown and modern developments in Arbor and Possumtown means nest locations vary — older homes often have unscreened vents and gaps in fascia where yellow jackets burrow into wall cavities, while newer construction can still harbor carpenter bee galleries in deck posts and pergolas. Our team knows Piscataway architecture and adapts treatment to the structure and the species.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet nest in Piscataway?
faqs.answer: We schedule most Piscataway wasp and hornet removals within 24 hours of the call. Aggressive nests near entries, play areas, or inside living spaces are prioritized. Call (855) 930-5016 and we'll confirm timing and access requirements on the phone.

faqs.question: What does the nest removal service include?
faqs.answer: Every service includes species identification, locating the nest entrance, treating the nest directly, removing accessible nest material, sealing entry points to prevent recolonization, and a service agreement. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Piscataway?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will yellow jackets or wasps come back after the nest is removed?
faqs.answer: Once the nest is treated and removed, we seal every entry point the insects used — gaps in siding, soffit vents, weep holes, wood cracks. Sealing the structure prevents recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
